body: Environment quirks that repeatedly broke tool calls this session: (1) The Bash tool + inline `for ... do ... done` fails with `(eval):N: parse error near 'done'` (a hook/zsh wrapper mangles multi-line loops). Fix: write the loop to a temp script and `sh /tmp/x.sh`. Single commands and && chains are fine. Multi-flag `sed -i ''` and some inline ${#VAR} loops also choked — same fix, or use `perl -pi -e`. (2) `perl -pi -e 's/../../g' f1 f2 ...` is the reliable multi-file find/replace here. (3) The claude-in-chrome browser `navigate` REFUSES file:// and data: URLs ("Can't interact with browser-internal or unparseable URLs") — can't load a local test page or data-URL shim; verify cross-origin behavior via `curl -I` header checks + loading the deployed https page directly. (4) Use dedicated Read/Edit/Write/Grep tools, not cat/sed/echo, for file work.
